haste_active.label: Rapid Regeneration is the only choice (Haste Self already active)
haste_active.explanation: A level-50 Druid at full spell points, 20 levels down, with Haste Self already on. Rapid Regeneration is the only perma spell left, so it wins. Original: the scoring pass queues the cast and the real pass queues it again, six keys, two casts. Corrected: one cast, three keys.
